title: Record the chirp field width
body:
## Summary
- Every residue modulo `2^w`, for `w` from 2 through 12, fits in `w` bits, and the modulus itself does not.
- Every pair of those residues sums to less than `2^(w+1)`, so the representative needs at most one subtraction. There are 22,369,616 pairs.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
